name: tool-autopsy
description: Explain why my agent called the wrong tool or kept failing, and give me a fix I can verify. Analyze supplied traces, configurations and tool schemas; return an event-linked diagnosis, corrected arguments or a minimal patch, and a safe reproduction checklist. No live connection, trace upload or automatic replay is provided.

interface.shortDescription: Find why my tool call failed
interface.longDescription: Explain why my agent called the wrong tool or kept failing, and give me a fix I can verify. Analyze supplied traces, configurations and tool schemas; return an event-linked diagnosis, corrected arguments or a minimal patch, and a safe reproduction checklist. No live connection, trace upload or automatic replay is provided.
defaultPrompt: Read this failed trace and explain the earliest supported failure.
Fix these tool arguments using the schema I pasted.
Plan a safe verification without sending the message again.
